links.outcome: LLM diagnostic accuracy differences across age subgroups and disease categories
links.effect: Patients under 50 had significantly higher odds of correct diagnosis with Copilot (OR = 3.36; 95% CI 1.16-9.71; p = 0.025); ChatGPT-4 and Claude sensitivity <67% for neoplastic diseases.
links.quote: Patients under 50 years old had a significantly higher probability of receiving a correct diagnosis with Copilot (OR = 3.36; 95% CI [1.16-9.71]; p = 0.025).

links.outcome: Comparison of four candidate LLMs' diagnostic accuracy on same patient data against expert diagnoses
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 86.41%, Claude AI 85.44%, Copilot 75.73%, Gemini 71.84%; inter-model kappa 0.43 to 0.59. Compared against each other, not against clinicians.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4 achieved the highest diagnostic accuracy (86.41%), followed by Claude AI (85.44%), Copilot (75.73%), and Gemini (71.84%).

screen.reason: Evaluates diagnostic accuracy of commercial LLMs (ChatGPT-4, Gemini, Copilot, Claude) on retrospective clinical vignettes from an African rheumatology department compared to expert-confirmed diagnoses, without testing a deployment practice.
